title: Bad packaging
text:
Bad packaging. I am so disappointed with these! I was really excited as I love the look of this type of topiary but when they arrived they were not what I expected.

The stem is disproportionately thick to the size of the leaf ball. While it is bottom heavy, it looks unbalanced. The leaf ball was too small and very very smashed on arrival. The leaves were folded and the ball was misshapen. I tried to smooth them out but they have creases in them.

The bottom of the box was full of loose leaves that had fallen out. More fell off while I was trying to fix it.
